meaning.en: the Goddess alone existed, gathered within herself
meaning.hi: देवी अकेली एकाग्र थीं

meaning.en: she alone brought the egg-shaped universe into being
meaning.hi: उन्होंने ही जगदंड की रचना की

meaning.en: she is known as the power of desire
meaning.hi: वे कामकला कहलाती हैं

meaning.en: she is known as the power of beauty
meaning.hi: वे शृंगारकला कहलाती हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasyah eva brahma vishnuh rudrah ajijanat

meaning.en: from her alone Brahma, Vishnu, and Rudra were born
meaning.hi: उन्हीं से ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र जन्मे

meaning.en: every troop of storm gods was born from her
meaning.hi: सभी मरुद्गण उन्हीं से जन्मे

meaning.en: the celestial musicians, dancers, half-human singers and all music-makers arose from her
meaning.hi: गंधर्व, अप्सरा, किन्नर, वादित्रवादक सब उन्हीं से उपजे

words.sanskrit: bhogyam ajijanat sarvam ajijanat sarvam shaktam ajijanat

meaning.en: she gave rise to everything meant for enjoyment, indeed to everything, every power
meaning.hi: भोग्य, सब कुछ, सारी शक्ति उन्हीं से उपजी

words.sanskrit: andajam svedajam udbhijjam jarayujam yat kinchaitat prani sthavara-jangamam manushyam ajijanat

meaning.en: egg-born, sweat-born, sprouted, womb-born, whatever is alive, rooted or moving, human or otherwise, she brought into being
meaning.hi: अंडज, स्वेदज, उद्भिज्ज, जरायुज, स्थावर-जंगम, मनुष्य जो भी है, सब उन्हीं से उत्पन्न

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this is the highest power
meaning.hi: यही परा शक्ति है

meaning.en: it is the same as Shambhavi wisdom
meaning.hi: यही शांभवी विद्या है

words.sanskrit: kadi-vidya iti va hadi-vidya iti va sadi-vidya iti va

meaning.en: or called Kadi wisdom, Hadi wisdom, or Sadi wisdom
meaning.hi: या कादिविद्या, हादिविद्या, सादिविद्या कहलाती है

meaning.en: its secret rests hidden established within speech
meaning.hi: इसका रहस्य वाणी में प्रतिष्ठित है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: she alone pervades the three cities and the three bodies
meaning.hi: वे ही त्रिपुर और त्रिशरीर में व्याप्त हैं

meaning.en: lighting up the outer and inner at once
meaning.hi: बाहर-भीतर प्रकाशित करती हुई

meaning.en: through connection with place, time, and object she is Mahatripurasundari
meaning.hi: देश-काल-वस्तु के संग से महात्रिपुरसुंदरी

meaning.en: the consciousness turned inward, facing itself
meaning.hi: प्रत्यक्-चिति

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: saiva atma tato anyam asatyam anatma

meaning.en: she alone is the self; anything apart from her is unreal, not-self
meaning.hi: वे ही आत्मा हैं, उनसे अन्य असत्य, अनात्मा है

meaning.en: therefore she is Brahman's knowing, free of every passing mood
meaning.hi: अतः यह ब्रह्मसंवित्ति भावभाव-कला-विनिर्मुक्त है

meaning.en: the knowledge of consciousness, the non-dual Brahman-knowing, a wave of being-awareness-bliss
meaning.hi: चिद्विद्या अद्वितीय ब्रह्मसंवित्ति सच्चिदानंदलहरी

meaning.en: entering outer and inner, she alone shines
meaning.hi: बाहर-भीतर प्रविष्ट होकर स्वयं ही प्रकाशित

words.sanskrit: yad asti sanmatram yad vibhati chinmatram yat priyam anandam tad etat purva-akara maha-tripurasundari

meaning.en: whatever exists is being, whatever appears is awareness, whatever brings joy is her original form
meaning.hi: जो है सन्मात्र, जो प्रकट है चिन्मात्र, जो प्रिय-आनंद वह पूर्वाकार महात्रिपुरसुंदरी

words.sanskrit: tvam cha aham cha sarvam vishvam sarva-devata itarat sarvam maha-tripurasundari

meaning.en: you and I, the whole universe, every deity, everything else, is her
meaning.hi: तुम, मैं, सम्पूर्ण विश्व, सभी देवता, सब कुछ महात्रिपुरसुंदरी

words.sanskrit: satyam ekam lalita-akhyam vastu tad advitiyam akhandartham param brahma

meaning.en: one single truth called Lalita, undivided, whole, the highest Brahman
meaning.hi: एक सत्य ललिता नाम की वस्तु, अद्वितीय अखंडार्थ परब्रह्म

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: by giving up the five coverings (koshas)
meaning.hi: पाँच रूपों के त्याग से

meaning.en: by letting go of every lesser, changing form
meaning.hi: दुर्रूप-प्रहाण से

words.sanskrit: adhishthanam param tattvam ekam sat shishyate mahat

meaning.en: the single, supreme, unmoving reality alone remains, called the greatest truth
meaning.hi: अधिष्ठान परम तत्त्व एक ही सत् महत् शेष रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: "consciousness is Brahman"
meaning.hi: प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्म

words.sanskrit: aham brahma asmi iti va bhashyate

meaning.en: or it is stated as "I am Brahman"
meaning.hi: अहं ब्रह्मास्मि कहा जाता है

meaning.en: it is likewise expressed as "you are that"
meaning.hi: तत्त्वमसि इस प्रकार कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: ayam atma brahma iti va brahma eva aham asmi iti va

meaning.en: "this self is Brahman" or "Brahman alone I am"
meaning.hi: अयमात्मा ब्रह्म या ब्रह्मैवाहमस्मि

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah aham asmi iti va sah aham asmi iti va

meaning.en: whoever says "I am he" or "he is I"
meaning.hi: जो कहता है मैं वही हूँ, वह मैं हूँ

words.sanskrit: yah asau sah aham asmi iti va ya bhavyate

meaning.en: or holds the feeling "that very one is myself"
meaning.hi: या भाव रखता है वही मैं हूँ

meaning.en: is contemplating the sixteen-syllable Shri Vidya, the fifteen-lettered Mahatripurasundari
meaning.hi: यही षोडशी श्रीविद्या पंचदशाक्षरी महात्रिपुरसुंदरी है

words.sanskrit: balambike iti bagale iti va matangi iti svayamvara-kalyani iti bhuvaneshvari iti chamunde iti chande iti varahi iti tiraskarini iti raja-matangi iti va shuka-shyamale iti va laghu-shyamale iti va ashvarudhe iti va pratyangira dhumavati savitri gayatri sarasvati brahmananda-kale

meaning.en: known by many names: Balambika, Bagala, Matangi, Svayamvara Kalyani, Bhuvaneshvari, Chamunda, Chandi, Varahi, Tiraskarini, Rajamatangi, Sukashyamala, Lagushyamala, the one mounted on a horse, Pratyangira, Dhumavati, Savitri, Gayatri, Sarasvati, and the fullness of Brahman's bliss
meaning.hi: बालांबिका, बगला, मातंगी, स्वयंवरकल्याणी, भुवनेश्वरी, चामुण्डा, चण्डी, वाराही, तिरस्करिणी, राजमातंगी, शुकश्यामला, लघुश्यामला, अश्वारूढ़ा, प्रत्यंगिरा, धूमावती, सावित्री, गायत्री, सरस्वती, ब्रह्मानंदकला आदि नामों से जानी जाती हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the sacred verses rest within the highest, unchanging space
meaning.hi: ऋचाएँ परम अक्षर व्योम में हैं

meaning.en: the place where all the gods have taken their seat
meaning.hi: जहाँ सभी देवता आसीन हुए

words.sanskrit: yah tat na veda kim richa karishyati

meaning.en: what use are those verses to one who does not know this
meaning.hi: जो इसे नहीं जानता, उसके लिए ऋचा किस काम की

words.sanskrit: ya it tad viduh te ime samasate

meaning.en: those who truly know it live there already, at peace
meaning.hi: जो सच में जानते हैं वे वहीं बसे रहते हैं

meaning.en: so says this Upanishad
meaning.hi: यह उपनिषद है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
